statement: ∀ h : ℝ, 0<h → let k := intervalIntegral (fun t : ℝ => Real.sinc (Real.pi*t)^2) (-h) h MeasureTheory.volume; 0≤k ∧ k≤1 ∧ 1-2/(9*h)≤k

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖第三批 · FR-9008 · 给归一化 sinc 核一个显式截断尾界
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage III · FR-9008 · Bound the truncated mass of the normalized sinc kernel

brief.zh: 从单位区间指示函数的 Plancherel 得全质量 1。用 |sin|≤1 和 π>3 控制两侧积分尾。对每个 h>0 同时适用。
brief.en: Use Plancherel on the indicator of the unit interval to obtain total mass one. Bound both tails with |sin|≤1 and π>3. The estimate is uniform for every h>0.
